name: Nitou Ou Mono wa Ittou mo Ezu
original_name: 二刀追うものは一刀も得ず
source:
You are a feudal lord in past Japan. You don't have a successor yet so lots of girls go crazy about you. They pull down their panties in front of you just so to have the chance to bear the next ruler. Frenzies of raging princesses that compete each other for your seed is a norm around your castle. Reverse rapes are common as well. Yet no one has ever been able to bear your child. No, no one has ever been able to have sex with you... Because you are an impo.
One day, just as usual, girls are introduced to you in the hope that their gorgeousness might cause your little limpy to go stiffy... Instead of meeting a girl, your vassal introduced two katanas named Kotetsu and Muramasa. And right when you touch, the blades transform into girls...


[edited from [url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?t=13209]kaorinusantara[/url]]
translation:
你是过去日本的一位封建领主。你还没有继任者，所以很多女孩都为你疯狂。他们在你面前脱下内裤，只是为了有机会承受下一个统治者。愤怒的公主们疯狂地争夺你的种子，这是你城堡周围的常态。反向强奸也很常见。但从来没有人能够生下你的孩子。不，从来没有人能够和你发生性关系……因为你是个小混蛋。
有一天，像往常一样，女孩们被介绍给你，希望她们的美丽能让你的小跛子变得僵硬……你的封臣没有见到一个女孩，而是介绍了两把武士刀，名叫虎彻和村正。一旦触碰，刀刃就会变成少女……
